# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 (Wave 2) Package 1: Byzantine Renaissance 3-Way Intellectual Debate (oe_ren_). Generated by gen_byz_renaissance.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Byzantine Renaissance decisions (oe_ren_). All carry real gold/clergy/stability trade-offs.

# 1. Patronize the Imperial Academy (repeatable up to Tier 3, 60m cooldown).
oe_ren_dec_patronize_academy = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_ren_is_empire = yes
        oe_ren_is_active = yes
        has_variable = oe_ren_academy_tier
        var:oe_ren_academy_tier < 3
    }
    allow = {
        oe_ren_holds_city = yes
        gold >= 150
        stability >= 5
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_dec_acad_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = 15
        if = { limit = { gold < 350 } subtract = 15 }
    }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:clergy } }
    option = {
        name = oe_ren_dec_patronize_academy.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -150
            set_variable = { name = oe_ren_dec_acad_cd months = 60 }
            oe_ren_academy_bump = yes
            oe_ren_push_renaissance_city = { val = 15 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ren_academy_patronage years = 10 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# 2. Summon Scholars to Mystras & Constantinople (repeatable, 60m cooldown).
oe_ren_dec_summon_scholars = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_ren_is_empire = yes
        oe_ren_is_active = yes
    }
    allow = {
        gold >= 120
        stability >= 0
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_dec_scholars_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = 10
        if = { limit = { gold < 300 } subtract = 10 }
    }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_ren_dec_summon_scholars.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -120
            add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
            set_variable = { name = oe_ren_dec_scholars_cd months = 60 }
            oe_ren_shift = { hes = -10 neo = 4 hum = 6 }
            oe_ren_tension_add = { amount = 6 }
            oe_ren_push_renaissance = { val = 12 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ren_summoned_scholars years = 10 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# 3. Fund the Imperial Greek Printing Press (one-time from 1455, unlocks Scriptorium cabinet action).
oe_ren_dec_fund_greek_press = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        oe_ren_is_empire = yes
        oe_ren_is_active = yes
        current_date >= 1455.1.1
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_press_built }
    }
    allow = {
        oe_ren_holds_city = yes
        gold >= 200
        stability >= 5
    }
    ai_will_do = {
        value = 25
        if = { limit = { gold < 400 } subtract = 25 }
    }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_ren_dec_fund_greek_press.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -200
            add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
            set_variable = oe_ren_press_built
            oe_ren_academy_bump = yes
            oe_ren_shift = { hes = -6 neo = 4 hum = 10 }
            oe_ren_tension_add = { amount = 8 }
            oe_ren_push_renaissance = { val = 20 }
            location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ren_golden_horn_press years = -1 mode = replace } }
        }
    }
}
